messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "stop taking if diarrhea is watery or bloody"
set: ["stop taking if diarrhea is watery or bloody", "call your doctor at once if you have watery or bloody diarrhea", "call your doctor before using anti-diarrhea medicine if you have watery or bloody diarrhea", "stop taking", "stop taking medicine", "stop using and call doctor at once if bloody or tarry stools", "temporarily stop taking if you have surgery", "stop taking this medicine", "stop taking and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "call doctor if diarrhea occurs", "do not stop taking suddenly", "watery or has blood in it", "stop taking and tell doctor right away if pregnant", "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately", "stop taking if you have a painful penis erection", "stop treatment if child is not growing or gaining weight as expected"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "call your doctor at once if you have watery or bloody diarrhea",
    "call your doctor before using anti-diarrhea medicine if you have watery or bloody diarrhea",
    "stop using and call doctor at once if bloody or tarry stools",
    "stop taking and tell doctor immediately if pregnant",
    "stop taking and tell doctor right away if pregnant",
    "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately"
  ],
  "alias": "stop taking if diarrhea is watery or bloody"
}
